method: Single unblinded agent inspected all36 fixed-prompt outputs,12 per model; not a human preference study.
finding: All12 longer-budget continuations still contain malformed words or broken grammar; prompt-related entities/events often drift. Reliable narrative coherence improvement remains unestablished.
example: Dog prompt,seed1729 begins a little bird. It then continues They he was she because the toys sturprised to her friend.
decision: Keep live model004; preserve the lower-loss candidate for further controlled experiments. Do not publish on loss alone.
